links.comparator_used: Prompt A (default prompt with no reading-level instruction) vs Prompt B (sixth-grade level using FKGL)
links.outcome: Readability (FKGL) of LLM-generated patient education materials on childhood myopia
links.effect: Readability improved with prompt B; ChatGPT-4o (o1) FKGL 6 ± 0.6 and ChatGPT-3.5 FKGL 6.2 ± 0.3 reached sixth-grade level; Gemini FKGL 7 ± 0.6 did not.
links.tradeoff: DISCERN quality declined from prompt A to B for ChatGPT-4o (p = 0.001) and ChatGPT-3.5 (p = 0.013); Gemini quality improved with prompt B (p = 0.02). All PEMs failed the 70% actionability threshold (40%).
links.quote: Readability improved with prompt B; ChatGPT-4o (01) and ChatGPT-3.5 achieved a sixth-grade level or below (FGKL 6 ± 0.6 and 6.2 ± 0.3), while Google Gemini did not (FGKL 7 ± 0.6).
